title: WEATHER FORECAST FOR 14 MAY 2026 Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 14 May 2026. The low pressure area located northeast of the Sri Lanka, still persist. this system is expected to move away from Sri Lanka and gradually weaken during the next 36 hours. Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in Western, Sabaragamuwa, Central, Southern, North-western and Northern provinces. Heavy falls about 100 mm are likely at some places in Western, Sabaragamuwa, Central and North-western provinces and in Galle and Matara districts. Showers or thundershowers may occur elsewhere of the island after 1.00 pm. The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.
